name: MCP · Round 1
domainSummary: A client-server protocol for structured context exchange in which a host maintains dedicated clients to servers, negotiates capabilities and lifecycle, and exchanges tools, resources, prompts, requests, responses, and notifications over defined transports.
evidenceBoundary: Do not draw AI agents, chat UI, plug icons, logos, JSON-RPC text, or network diagrams. Keep the protocol exchange architectural and physically joined.

researchSources.title: MCP architecture overview
researchSources.use: Official participants, layers, lifecycle, primitives, notifications, and transports.

assets.name: MCP · Canonical Instrument
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building; emphasize host client server separation
assets.thesis: The accepted skill identity is tested in its clearest production form. This version emphasizes host client server separation.

assets.name: MCP · Core Mechanism
assets.controlledVariable: make the skill's defining mechanism the central architectural mass; emphasize capability negotiation and lifecycle
assets.thesis: One unmistakable mechanism carries the identity. This version emphasizes capability negotiation and lifecycle.

assets.name: MCP · Flow Spine
assets.controlledVariable: organize inputs, work, and outputs along one connected linear spine; emphasize tool resource and prompt docks
assets.thesis: A legible flow tests the skill as a transformation process. This version emphasizes tool resource and prompt docks.

assets.name: MCP · Interface Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: join two unequal functional masses through one explicit inhabited interface bridge; emphasize request response exchange
assets.thesis: The skill is expressed as a reliable boundary between systems. This version emphasizes request response exchange.

assets.name: MCP · Layered System
assets.controlledVariable: stack several connected layers with visibly different responsibilities; emphasize transport-independent protocol boundary
assets.thesis: Layering tests separation of concerns and system depth. This version emphasizes transport-independent protocol boundary.

assets.name: MCP · Modular Field
assets.controlledVariable: repeat small interoperable units on one shared base with a clear coordinating core; emphasize host client server separation
assets.thesis: Modularity and composition become the identity. This version emphasizes host client server separation.

assets.name: MCP · Verified Core
assets.controlledVariable: protect a compact central chamber behind explicit gates, checks, or controlled thresholds; emphasize capability negotiation and lifecycle
assets.thesis: Correctness and validation dominate the architectural metaphor. This version emphasizes capability negotiation and lifecycle.

assets.name: MCP · Scale Engine
assets.controlledVariable: extend the building through repeated service bays and resilient parallel paths; emphasize tool resource and prompt docks
assets.thesis: Performance and scale are expressed through structure, not speed lines. This version emphasizes tool resource and prompt docks.

assets.name: MCP · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the skill to a minimal but complete map-readable technical building; emphasize request response exchange
assets.thesis: The primitive tests the smallest recognizable expression of the skill. This version emphasizes request response exchange.

assets.name: MCP · Skill Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: combine mechanism, flow, interface, validation, and scale in one balanced supporting building; emphasize transport-independent protocol boundary
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a complete skill identity while remaining subordinate to projects and cities. This version emphasizes transport-independent protocol boundary.
